title: runHooks
responsibility: Installs, removes, reports and runs the opt-in hooks of a worktree: the pre-push verification gate and the commit-msg gate that measures a commit message.

inputs.name: manageHooks.action
inputs.description: Selects whether to install, uninstall, or report the opt-in hooks for the worktree.

inputs.name: manageHooks.command
inputs.description: Command string passed to the hook installer when the action is install. Defaults to `harness`.

inputs.name: manageHooks.root
inputs.description: Root path used to locate the Git working tree for hook management. It is resolved to an absolute path and defaults to `process.cwd()` when omitted.

inputs.name: runHook.stage
inputs.description: Hook stage requested for execution. This implementation accepts only `pre-push`; other stage strings fail.

inputs.name: runHook.input
inputs.description: Input string Git supplied to the hook, passed to the pre-push runner after the stage check. It matters for the pre-push gate.

inputs.name: runHook.root
inputs.description: Root path used to locate the Git working tree for the hook run. It is resolved to an absolute path and defaults to `process.cwd()` when omitted.

inputs.name: checkMessage.file
inputs.description: Path to the commit-message file Git supplied to the commit-msg hook. A missing or empty path causes an expected CLI error.

inputs.name: checkMessage.root
inputs.description: Root path used to locate the Git working tree for the message check. It is resolved to an absolute path and defaults to `process.cwd()` when omitted.

inputs.name: renderHooks.status
inputs.description: Hook status supplied to the formatter. It reads the stage, installed and enabled flags, hooks directory, chained state, stage entries, and limitations.

limitations: `git push --no-verify` skips the hook; only CI checks every push.
The hooks directory is shared: other worktrees of this repository run the hook only after `harness hooks install` is run there.
A stage acts only where it was opted into: a worktree that ran `harness hooks install` under an earlier Harness keeps the stages it asked for then, until the command is run there again.
Only pushes of branches are checked; tags and deletions are not.
Before a commit exists only its message is measured: a commit that does not exist yet cannot be verified exactly.
`git commit --no-verify` skips the commit-msg hook; verification measures the stored messages again.

inputs.name: renderHookOutcome.outcome
inputs.description: Pre-push outcome supplied to the formatter. It reads verified commits and their records, plus blocked commits and their failure messages.

outputs.name: manageHooks
outputs.description: Resolves to the hook status returned by the install, uninstall, or status service for the selected worktree. Its root must resolve to a Git working tree.

limitations: `git push --no-verify` skips the hook; only CI checks every push.
The hooks directory is shared: other worktrees of this repository run the hook only after `harness hooks install` is run there.
A stage acts only where it was opted into: a worktree that ran `harness hooks install` under an earlier Harness keeps the stages it asked for then, until the command is run there again.
Only pushes of branches are checked; tags and deletions are not.
Before a commit exists only its message is measured: a commit that does not exist yet cannot be verified exactly.
`git commit --no-verify` skips the commit-msg hook; verification measures the stored messages again.

outputs.name: runHook
outputs.description: Resolves to the pre-push runner outcome when the stage is `pre-push` and the root is a Git working tree. Other stage names fail before the runner is called.

outputs.name: checkMessage
outputs.description: Resolves to the commit-message service's list of findings for the file Git supplied. The list can be empty.

outputs.name: renderHooks
outputs.description: Formatted hook status text, including installation and worktree enablement state, commit-msg guidance, and local-hook limitations.
examples:
The pre-push hook is not installed in /workspace/project/.git/hooks and not enabled for this worktree.
The commit-msg hook is not installed and not enabled for this worktree. It measures a commit message where the repository declares the writing limits.
Limits of a local hook:

outputs.name: renderHookOutcome
outputs.description: Formatted lines for verified and blocked commits. Verified lines include shortened commit and record identifiers; blocked commits include shortened commit identifiers and their failure messages.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown when the selected root is not a Git working tree, when `runHook` receives a stage other than `pre-push`, or when `checkMessage` receives no message-file path.
